title: The two environment kinds reach the shared runtime contract and the generated client
description:
Prerequisite LEAF carved out of task-a2409cba9ad841a690961692a2948c41 by worker-caece97b (acting as architect on a claimed PLANNING row), 2026-09-05. Second of two leaves; the other is task-d0d1cb5c3f034d50bd84b7ed56b7e812 (the MCP/human-only fence). a2409cba measured 13 forced file edits against the 10-file cap and submit_plan refused it at 11 with [CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION]. Parent chain: SPIDR child 1b of task-9ae492b373fa4e7aa6b1e91585f6e612.

WHY THIS SEAM IS REAL, unlike the one tried first. The daemon's PAYLOAD_KEYS roster and the shared RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS roster are deliberately NOT set-equal, and the codebase says so in its own words at apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-create-with-source.ts:35 - "kind `goal.create_with_source` is in `RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS` but NOT in" the daemon table. A kind may therefore exist on the shared contract with no daemon registry entry: an established, deliberate state, not a hole this row invents.

CONTRAST, so nobody re-proposes the OTHER split: apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts:238 DOES weld the daemon's PAYLOAD_KEYS to the v2 registry by set-equality, which is why the daemon vocabulary and the daemon registry cannot be separated and stay together in a2409cba.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS in packages/contracts, its hand-transcribed test roster, and the REGENERATED control-room client. NO daemon vocabulary, NO PAYLOAD_KEYS, NO registry, NO handler, NO MCP roster - a2409cba and task-d0d1cb5c own those.

MEASURED SEAMS (worker-caece97b at HEAD f3b94eaa):
- packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:85-117 - RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS, a frozen alphabetical tuple. runtime-contract.test.ts:124 asserts sortedness, so insert in sorted position.
- packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-contract.test.ts:103-104 - `expect(RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS).toEqual(EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS)` against a HAND-TRANSCRIBED list, plus a LITERAL count of 102. That file's own header at :30-32 explains a derived expectation would be vacuous. Transcribe by hand; do NOT replace it with RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS.length.
- packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.js is `export * from "./runtime-vocabulary.ts";` - a star re-export. NO EDIT NEEDED.
- packages/control-room-client/src/generated/generated-client.ts:907 - GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST, currently ed5f6b87cfca761b4389d66429046f5f2420f9fa04a373c1f22ab0608bfb8076. Re-read it rather than trusting this value.
- packages/control-room-client/package.json:18 - the generator is `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`.
- TWO GREEN-CHECKS, NOT EDITS: src/contract-digest.test.ts:21 (deriveContractDigest equals the pin) and src/generated-coverage.test.ts:89-90 (generated builder set equals RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS, asserted in BOTH directions). Both go green on their own once the generator runs. If either needs hand-editing, the generator did not run or the contract edit was wrong.
- apps/daemon/src/cutover/v2-surface-manifest.ts:86 builds GLOBAL_COMMANDS from RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS. Check it does not demand a matching daemon entry before assuming the daemon suite stays green.
definitionOfDone: `environment.set_variable` and `environment.unset_variable` are members of RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS in packages/contracts, inserted in SORTED position (runtime-contract.test.ts:124 asserts sortedness).

runtime-contract.test.ts gains both kinds in its HAND-TRANSCRIBED EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS and its literal count moves 102 -> 104, with the transcribed form preserved - replacing it with a derived length is a regression that file's header at :30-32 forbids. Prove the arm still bites: remove ONE kind from the production roster, confirm the test REDS, restore.

The generated client is REGENERATED with `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`, never hand-edited, and BOTH the OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST are quoted verbatim in the completion record.

contract-digest.test.ts and generated-coverage.test.ts are GREEN WITHOUT BEING EDITED - quote their `Test Files N passed` count line. If either required an edit, say so and explain why, because it means the generator was bypassed.

PROVE THE DAEMON IS UNDISTURBED, since this row deliberately leaves both kinds absent from the daemon's PAYLOAD_KEYS: run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and attribute any red per global rail 3 (HEAD failures minus merge-base failures, intersected with owned paths). Name `goal.create_with_source` as the precedent that makes this intermediate state legitimate.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm test` (the root include DOES cover packages/**, so this row is genuinely covered by it), `pnpm typecheck`, and the daemon run above as the attribution baseline.
taskRails: NEVER HAND-EDIT the generated client. Run the generator and quote the OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST.

ADD ONLY, IN SORTED POSITION. Do not reorder or remove any existing kind - runtime-contract.test.ts asserts both the exact roster and its sortedness, and a reorder is the silent edit those arms exist to catch.

NO DAEMON WORK. Do not touch daemon-command-vocabulary.ts, PAYLOAD_KEYS, the registry, the MCP roster or HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS - those belong to task-a2409cba and task-d0d1cb5c. Adding these kinds to the daemon's PAYLOAD_KEYS here would red daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts:238.

A kind on the shared contract with no daemon registry entry is a DELIBERATE, EXISTING state - goal.create_with_source is the precedent (goal-create-with-source.ts:35). Do not 'complete' the wiring to make it look finished.
